born.why: The code improves by explicitly tracking per-species safety history to avoid known poisons and prioritize safe foods, while using a hunger-threshold logic to decide between cautious tasting of novel fruits and desperate eating when starving.

The previous code failed because it didn't distinguish between "safe" and "poisonous" novel fruits effectively, leading to unnecessary risks or missed opportunities; this version prioritizes emergency eating at high hunger, strictly avoids confirmed poisons, eats fully if the fruit is known safe, and only tastes novel fruits when not starving, optimizing for survival through better risk management.

The code prioritizes safety by tracking harm vs. benefit history per species, trusts innate drives for known-good fruits, and uses high-hunger override to prevent starvation while still preferring safe options, ensuring Fagi lives longer by avoiding repeated poisoning of unknown or previously harmful fruits.
The code prioritizes survival by ignoring known poisonous fruits, cautiously tasting risky ones only when starving, and aggressively carrying/eating safe fruits to build energy reserves.

The code prioritizes survival by avoiding fruits with a history of harm, cautiously testing novel fruits only when not critically starving, and aggressively eating known-safe fruits when hungry to maximize long-term foraging efficiency.

The code tracks specific fruit key history to distinguish safe vs. poisonous species, using a "taste first" strategy for novel fruits when hunger is manageable to avoid fatal poisoning, and prioritizes eating/carrying for confirmed safe foods when hungry, while explicitly avoiding known poisons regardless of hunger.
